title: glechoma lamiopsis
intro: Glechoma lamiopsis, commonly known as Chinese creeping thyme, is a type of flowering plant in the mint family, Lamiaceae. It has been used in traditional Chinese medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation, improve digestion, and boost the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Glechoma lamiopsis include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its potential in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
